title: 🔬 ANRF ₹1 Lakh Crore RDI Fund & Deep-Tech Innovation Framework
executiveSummary: Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).
masterKeyFacts: Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).
DPIIT revised 2019 rules: Deep-tech start-ups recognized up to 20 years (turnover ₹300 Cr); non-deep-tech turnover raised to ₹200 Cr (10 years).
DBT's BIRAC appointed second-level manager to deploy ₹2,000 Cr under ₹1L Cr RDI framework.
